kaikki_vikisozluk.e: قُبُورِيّ • (qubūriyy) (feminine قُبُورِيَّة (qubūriyya), masculine plural قُبُورِيُّون (qubūriyyūn), feminine plural قُبُورِيَّات (qubūriyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic قُبُور (qubūr)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic قبوري
From قُبُور (qubūr, “graves, tombs”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
g: a heterodox or heretical frequenter of mausoleums of saints and other virtuous persons (as for petitions, votive undertakings, seeking intercession, and so on); a supposed venerator or worshiper of graves (typically, though not exclusively, applied to Sufis)
